title: finding(docs): three public-block examples outside objectui#11183's roots still write row keys flat (`record:related_list` ×2, app-shell README `action:button` ×2), and the host feed slots `items` / `entries` are refused without being named
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a published teaching that the strict authoring face refuses, with named landing sites. Reader: triage first (grade and route; the fix is in `content/docs/**` and a package README — `domain:devx` / `domain:ui`, the objectui#10872 family). Filed by the `domain:skills @ objectui` seat (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#11311) from the contract review of PR objectui#11317 (card objectui#11183), record on that PR, ③ item 6 and ①(e). ⛔ Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` named producers. `content/docs/**` is the published docs site; `packages/app-shell/README.md` ships in the `@object-ui/app-shell` tarball (`files` lists `README.md`), so an npm consumer reads it at `node_modules/@object-ui/app-shell/README.md`.

## Item 1 — three flat public-block examples outside objectui#11183's roots

objectui#11183 (PR objectui#11317) moved every taught `action:*` node under `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md` into the spec's `properties` bag (ruling A: the bag is the contract, ADR-0089 D3a). Its rider asked to widen the census to every public-block example under those roots; the claim fixed the surface to the named sites, so these remain, measured at objectui `main` by the at-tier review:

- `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` — a `record:related_list` node written flat: `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `columns` (members of `RecordRelatedListProps`) plus `actions`, which is not a row member at all.
- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` — the same node written flat inside a blockquote: `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `title`, `columns`.
- `packages/app-shell/README.md` — two `action:button` nodes with flat `actionType` (`navigate_create` / `navigate_edit`, under "The handler name goes in `actionType`").

`RecordRelatedListBlockSchema` and `ActionButtonBlockSchema` are bagged (`propsBag(...)`), so each example is refused by `StrictAnyComponentSchema` and by the spec's strict page component exactly as the `action:*` nodes were before PR objectui#11317 — and PR objectui#11069 will make `objectui validate` refuse them. The runtime reads both spellings through the `SchemaRenderer` hoist, so the fix is documents only. The dev of PR objectui#11317 named the README pair in its report (`out_of_scope_findings`); the two `record:related_list` sites are the review's.

## Item 2 — the two host feed slots are refused without being named

`record:activity` takes `items` on the node as a host-supplied feed (`record-activity.tsx`: "a host that already owns the feed passes it in, exactly as `record:history` takes `entries`"), and `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` correctly teaches it in TSX composition. But `items` is not a `RecordActivityProps` member, so an author who writes it in JSON — flat or in the bag — gets a bare `unrecognized_keys` from both authoring faces, with nothing saying it is a runtime slot. `record:history`'s `entries` is in the same unnamed state (`RecordHistoryBlockSchema` declares no `entries`). The contrast is `action:button`'s `onClick`, which is refused by name (`handlerKeyRefusal`). This is the AI-proofing axis: an agent copying the README's `items` into a schema document is refused without being told the key belongs to the host.

## Dedupe

The objectui#10872 thread (the flat-vs-bag family) and the objectui#11183 thread (body + 4 comments) name neither `record:related_list` nor the app-shell README nodes nor the feed slots; the review of PR objectui#11317 is the first reading of all three. Dedupe words: `record:related_list flat properties bag slotted-pages` · `app-shell README action:button navigate_create properties bag` · `record:activity items runtime slot unrecognized_keys` · `record:history entries unnamed refusal`.

Hands-on reader: triage (grade, route, split item 2 off if it is a different fix); then the owning seat.
